content.comment_body: Hello, can anyone assist with this error? [product_name] v8.1.1 has no issues, but after updating to v8.2, an error message appears on startup. Thank you. [user_name]
Are you using Windows 10? Maybe this [url] will help.

Yes, I'm on Windows 10, thank you! I’m working on resolving this—the problem seems to be related to switchable VGA graphics. The program launches fine when plugged in but shows an error message on battery. [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users encounter an error with [product_name] after upgrading to v8.2 on Windows 10. The previous version v8.1.1 works fine. The problem is connected to switchable VGA graphics and happens only when the device runs on battery, not when plugged into mains power. This points to a compatibility or power-management issue with the newer software version.
analysis.user_expectations: Users anticipate the newest version of [product_name] will work without errors on Windows 10, regardless of whether the device operates on battery or mains power.
